messages:
alex: Quick sync re: soft-commit tiers + controlled spillover for APAC micro-pools. Customer asks: predictable short bursts, bounded preemption, and clear billing.

maya: High level: baseline + short burst window with a transparent fallback. Agree?

kevin: Yep. Customers asking for ~2x baseline for bursts up to 30s without eviction. We discussed borrowable credits vs reservation.

liz: Two asks from ops: 1) exact preemption ordering between dedicated/micro/hosted; 2) how spilled requests are billed.

alex: Product opinion: preempt order = best-effort micro-pools -> regional backfill -> hosted. Billing: ship GA charging spilled at reserved rate (no extra host premium) to avoid surprise, but expose toggle.

maya: Can we express policy in a small config proto so runtime/ops can simulate? Example draft:

```
soft_commit_profile {
  baseline_tokens_per_min: 60000
  burst_factor: 2.0
  soft_window_secs: 30
  preempt_protection: false
  spill_policy: SPILL_TO_HOSTED
  billing_mode: PRORATED_RESERVED
}
```

kevin: Add per-tenant `preempt_protection: true` option as paid add-on. Also need metric hooks: evictions, spill_token_count, latency_p99.

liz: Ops: autoscaler needs burst shape (not just multiplier). Can analytics produce 95/99th percentile burst duration and arrival rate for pilot tenants? @ops-bot

ops-bot: Created job `analytics:apac_burst_shapes` for tenants tagged `soft-commit-pilot`. Daily summary to #eng-runtime.

alex: Launch criteria proposal: (A) proto + unit/integration tests for preempt order and spill, (B) canary in APAC with 3 pilot customers for 14 days, (C) dashboards for spill/cost/evictions, (D) runbook with manual drain & TTL override.

maya: MVP scope: behavior-first, billing toggle OFF for GA (simple). We'll enable billing-mode later once metrics stable.

kevin: I'll own canary plan and metrics. Plan: staged rollout, synthetic load tests to validate preempt ordering, compare actual spill to model.

liz: I'll own runbook and autoscale config. Add emergency TTL override and a manual soft-window extension for customers mid-burst.

alex: Action items: maya = proto + product doc draft, kevin = canary + test harness, liz = runbook + ops toggles. I'll draft SLA wording and schedule 30m sync Friday to sign off. If no objections by EOD Ill mark scope locked. :thumbsup:

maya: Will post draft doc and checklist (feature flag, dashboards, billing toggle, canary criteria) by tomorrow 11:00.

kevin: Note: add test case for simultaneous multi-tenant bursts to validate fair spill ordering.

liz: Ops request: add cost guardrails so pilot tenants can't spike billing runaway if billing-mode later turned on.

alex: Good point. Add a billing soft-cap with alerting for pilot.

maya: Thanks everyone 642 Will iterate on doc and proto.
